product_one_liner.value: ivoyant delivers custom digital-transformation solutions—including AI/ML and data analytics, cloud, integration, and web/mobile application development—for enterprise organizations.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer presents services, products, articles, case studies, careers and contact options, but no pricing link or public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: Both appear in the homepage Trusted by 50+ Companies logo wall.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains multiple technical posts, including LLM routing architecture and CI/CD/infrastructure/compliance engineering.

public_docs.notes: No docs, help-center or developer-portal link is exposed in the homepage navigation/footer.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open roles shown are UX/UI Designer Internship and Azure Platform Engineer—DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure; none matches the specified AI/ML/data-science titles.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed product and technical material discusses LLMs and gives GPT-4, Gemini and Claude as examples, but does not state which provider ivoyant uses in its product.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn describes ivoyant as unfunded and says it has not raised any funding rounds.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile says no funding rounds.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page lists UX/UI Designer Internship and Azure Platform Engineer, and no SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative or account-executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: Readable recent post history shows articles, recognition and business announcements, but no dated product or major-feature launch in the May 9–November 9, 2026 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small team page lists Basanth Gowda, Sonya Beredimas, Rajanikanth Pandiri and Robin Mathew, with no indication of a C-level/VP join or departure during the window.
